description: This file defines a React component named 'InputPanel' used for configuring and submitting evaluation inputs in a web application's user interface. It includes UI elements for setting evaluation mode, domain context, judge model, and text inputs for user question, context, and system response, along with preset loading functionality.

methods.name: InputPanel
methods.description: React component function for rendering the input configuration panel used in the evaluation interface.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles the form submission event, validating inputs and invoking the onSubmit callback with current state.

methods.name: loadPreset
methods.description: Loads a preset configuration into the form fields.

calls: onSubmit({ question, context, response, mode, domain, model })
